name: Merkle-Tree Anti-Entropy Replica Sync
description: Repair domain-separated hashing, tail-preserving chunking, odd-level Merkle promotion, minimal diff ranges, pull-direction sync, and idempotent repair counts.
planted_defect: chunker drops the final partial chunk
odd Merkle level re-hashes leftover instead of promoting it
diff_ranges returns the whole tree instead of minimal ranges
sync_with pushes local state into peer instead of pulling
repaired count returns op count not chunk count
